# Pinned wire contracts

Only the original Apache-2.0 protocol schemas and licenses are copied here. Generated C# is build output, not a fork of either control plane.

- `ax/ax.proto`: google/ax `a496fc1ff1cf9bea4c34924348e4119172cfea5b`, `pkg/apis/v1alpha1/ax.proto`.
- `substrate-env/guest.proto`: agent-substrate/env `4468a200b170` (`v0.0.11-0.20260912052224-4468a200b170`), `proto/ateenv/v1alpha/guest.proto`.

These match the tested AX/server/runner pins. Update contracts only with a reviewed platform upgrade and integration tests. No runtime secrets are included.
